meta.title: BugShot — Bug Reports in One Shot
meta.description: From design review and bug reporting to style fixes and issue creation. Stop jumping between DevTools, screenshot tools, and issue trackers.

hero.heading: Bug Reports in <brand>One Shot</brand>.
subcopy: Discover, fix, capture, and report bugs
hero.note: No sign-up required. Just install and go.

inspect.title: Inspect & Edit CSS
inspect.description: Click any element to view its styles, then tweak them live in the visual editor.

record.title: Capture & Record
record.description: Take annotated screenshots or record up to 60 seconds to catch the exact moment a bug happens.

log.title: Console & Network logs
log.description: Console errors and network requests are captured automatically — no need to reproduce the bug.

autoCollect.title: Auto-collect context
autoCollect.description: Browser, resolution, DOM, console, and network logs collected — with noise filtered out.

ai.title: AI bug reports
ai.description: Turn captured data into a structured report with steps, expected, and actual behavior.

submit.title: One-click issue filing
submit.description: Submit tickets with full attachments to Jira, GitHub, Linear, or Notion in one click.

connectTracker.title: Connect your tracker
connectTracker.description: Link Jira, GitHub, Linear, or Notion via OAuth or API key. Projects, labels, assignees, and priorities sync automatically — no reconfiguration needed when filing issues.

captureMode.title: Choose a capture mode
captureMode.description: Pick from screenshot, up to 60-second recording, element inspection, or freeform. During recording, console logs and network requests are captured automatically — headers and bodies included, with sensitive headers auto-masked.

editStyles.title: Edit the styles
editStyles.description: Click any element to edit CSS directly, or ask AI to change styles in plain language. Before-and-after snapshots and a diff table of changed properties are automatically included in the report.

aiDraft.title: AI generates a draft
aiDraft.description: Feeds collected environment info, logs, screenshots, and style diffs into AI to generate a structured report with reproduction steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior. Chrome's built-in AI works instantly; OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini just need an API key.

submitReport.title: Submit your report
submitReport.description: File the report to your tracker with screenshots, recordings, HAR logs, and console logs attached — inline on Jira. No tracker? Copy as Markdown + HTML and paste into Slack or Confluence.

trackIssues.title: Check issue status
trackIssues.description: View issue status in real time right inside BugShot. Transition Jira workflows, toggle GitHub Open/Closed, or change Linear states — all without leaving BugShot to open your tracker.

qe.author: 안**, QA Engineer
qe.quote: I used to juggle DevTools, screenshots, and Jira separately — now it all happens in the browser without breaking my flow. Replacing text explanations with visual diffs and recordings cut our back-and-forth way down.

designer.author: 김**, Product Designer
designer.quote: During design QA, I used to dig through DevTools to find element positions and capture changes separately. Now I can inspect and share fixes right on the page — the whole process is so much smoother.

backend.author: 성**, Backend Engineer
backend.quote: QA tickets that just say “it doesn’t work” are over. Network requests and console errors come attached automatically, so I see which API broke right away, and the AI drafts the repro steps. Debugging time dropped a lot.

frontend.author: 문**, Frontend Engineer
frontend.quote: I used to burn time reproducing bugs that came in as a single screenshot. Now one capture bundles console errors, network logs, and environment info automatically, so half the cause is visible the moment it lands.

bottomCta.heading: All your Bugs, <brand>One Workflow</brand>.
subcopy: From bug discovery to issue submission —

browser.a: BugShot works on Chrome and Chromium-based browsers like Edge, Brave, and Arc. Chrome 116 or later is required.

pricing.a: Yes, completely free with no sign-up required. Install and start reporting right away.

ai.q: What do I need to use the AI feature?
ai.a: Chrome's built-in AI works out of the box with no setup. To use external LLMs like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini, just enter your own API key.

integrations.a: Submit reports with attachments directly to Jira, GitHub, Linear, or Notion. You can also copy as Markdown and paste it wherever your team works.

privacy.a: All data is stored locally in your browser and is never sent to BugShot's servers. Data is only shared with the services you use — your issue tracker or AI provider — and local data is automatically deleted after submission.
